entities.summary: Oleksandr Vyacheslavovych Slobodian is a Ukrainian millionaire businessman and politician. He is the original CEO and current honorary president of the Kyiv-based Obolon CJSC, Europe's largest brewing company, and the president of the Ukrainian Premier League football club Obolon Kyiv.
